name: Mahidol University International College
description: Thailand's first public international college, part of Mahidol University. 17 English-taught bachelor majors.
programs: Computer Science; Computer Engineering; Applied Mathematics; Physics; Chemistry; Biological Sciences; Food Science & Technology; International Business; Finance; Marketing; Business Economics; International Relations & Global Affairs; Media & Communication; Communication Design; Creative Technology; Intercultural Studies & Languages; Travel & Service Business Entrepreneurship
ged_note: GED is listed as an accepted high school qualification.
ged_tests: GED: 145+ in each subject and 600+ total. SAT Math 600 / ACT 25 for Science, Engineering, Creative Tech and Business; 500 / 18 for Media & Travel; not needed for Design, IR and Languages
igcse_note: Needs a completed high school qualification. IGCSE alone is not enough, so add A-Levels or a GED.
admission: Apply online in an admission round → high school certificate (GED accepted) → English score → SAT/ACT Math where required.
scholarship: MUIC Global Talents Scholarship: 100,000 THB for Asian (non-Thai) students, plus financial aid grants. Interview after admission.

name: Chulalongkorn University (BISTech)
description: Thailand's oldest university. BISTech is its international BSc in Industrial Science and Technology at the School of Integrated Science.
ged_note: GED accepted with HSCES equivalency and GPA certificates. GED Science 165+ meets the science requirement.
igcse_note: Needs a completed high school qualification plus A-Level / IB / SAT for maths and science.
admission: Get HSCES certificates (about 7 days) → apply in a round → English, Maths, Science scores (20% each) → interview (40%).
intakes: Early: 26 Nov–25 Dec 2026 · Intl 1: 5 Jan–19 Feb 2027 · Round: 16–31 Mar 2027 · Intl 2: 1 Apr–7 May 2027
scholarship: Scholarship for Foreign Students (top 10 international admission scores) + Freshman Scholarship (25,500 THB, top admission scores). No separate application.

name: James Cook University Singapore
description: Singapore campus of James Cook University (Australia). Same degrees as in Australia, with three trimesters a year.
programs: Pre-University Foundation Program; Business; Information Technology; Psychology; Environmental Science
ged_note: GED is not listed. Each case is assessed against programme entry rules. Ask admissions-singapore@jcu.edu.au.
igcse_note: IGCSE with at least 4 passes (aggregate 11 points or better) for the 12-month Pre-University Foundation. Direct degree entry needs A-Levels (about ABB) or IB (about 30).
english: Foundation: IELTS 5.5 (no band below 5.0). Degree: IELTS 6.0–6.5
admission: Apply online at least 6 weeks before the start date → academic + English documents → Foundation (65% overall to progress) → bachelor.
scholarship: JCU Merit Scholarship (International): up to one year of tuition (8 subjects). Separate application + online test, by country deadline.

name: PSB Academy
description: Large private institution in Singapore with certificates and diplomas that lead to degrees with partner universities.
programs: Certificate programmes; Diploma in Business; Diploma in IT / Cyber Security; Diploma in Engineering; Foundation Diploma in Life Sciences
ged_note: GED accepted for diplomas. A GED total of 640+ also qualifies for the 40% merit scholarship.
igcse_note: IGCSE (1 pass) gives certificate-level entry. Diploma entry needs A-Levels, IB, Matriculation 50% or a certificate first.
admission: Apply through a PSB country manager → certificate → diploma → partner-university degree.
pathway: Certificate → Diploma → degree with partner university
scholarship: International Student Diploma Merit Scholarship: 40% off course fees. Myanmar: GED total 640+ or Matriculation 65%+.

name: Asia Pacific University (APU)
description: Tech-focused private university with a QS 5 Stars Plus rating. Optional dual degree with De Montfort University (UK).
partner: APU degree; optional dual award with De Montfort University (UK)
programs: Foundation → Computing & Technology; Software Engineering, Cyber Security, Data Science; Engineering; Business, Accounting & Finance; Psychology, International Relations; Architecture & Design
ged_note: GED is not listed. APU accepts equivalents on the MQA list, so confirm with admissions.
igcse_note: 5 credits (grade C or above), including Maths and English for most routes.
admission: Apply online with IGCSE results and passport → offer letter → student visa (EMGS) → Foundation (1 year) → degree.
scholarship: International Merit Award: up to 30% fee waiver. Foundation: IGCSE 9 A's = 30%, 8 A's = 20%, 6–7 A's = 10%.

name: Sunway University & College
description: Large non-profit private university near Kuala Lumpur, with A-Level and foundation programmes and degrees validated by Lancaster University (UK).
partner: Sunway degrees; Lancaster University (UK) validated programmes; Victoria University (Australia)
programs: Cambridge A-Level (1.5 years); Foundation in Arts / Science; Business & Accounting; Computing & IT; Engineering; Psychology; Medical Sciences
ged_note: GED is not listed. Sunway assesses each country and qualification. Confirm with the International Office.
igcse_note: IGCSE with 5 credits for Cambridge A-Level, plus IELTS 5.5. Students who finished Grade/Year 11 can apply for the pre-university bursary.
english: A-Level: IELTS 5.5 · Diploma: IELTS 5.0 · Degree: programme-specific
admission: Check eligibility with the International Office → apply online → offer letter → student visa (EMGS) → apply for the bursary online (deadline: 2 weeks after classes start).
pathway: A-Level or Foundation (1–1.5 years) → bachelor degree
scholarship: Sunway International Bursary: RM5,000 (pre-university), RM3,000 (diploma), RM6,000 or RM11,000 (degree). Apply online with results.

name: National University of Singapore (NUS)
description: Singapore's top public university. ASEAN students, including from Myanmar, are automatically considered for a full scholarship when they apply.
programs: Computing; Engineering; Business; Science; Medicine & Dentistry; Law; Humanities & Social Sciences
ged_note: GED is not listed in NUS international qualifications. Confirm with NUS Admissions before applying.
igcse_note: IGCSE alone is not enough. Students need A-Levels, IB or another completed high school qualification.
admission: Apply online for undergraduate admission → shortlisted students are invited to scholarship interviews (January–July) → results by mid-July.
scholarship: ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship: 100% of subsidised tuition, S$5,800/year living + S$3,000/year housing + S$1,750 computer allowance. No separate application. Tuition Grant requires 3 years of work in Singapore after graduation.

name: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)
description: One of Asia's top technological universities. ASEAN students, including from Myanmar, can apply for a full scholarship with their admission application.
programs: Computer Science & Data Science; Engineering; Business; Science; Medicine (LKC); Communication & Humanities
ged_note: GED is not listed. NTU has an "Other international qualifications" category, so confirm with NTU Admissions.
igcse_note: IGCSE alone is not enough. Students need A-Levels, IB or another Year 12 qualification.
admission: Apply online (international window: 15 Oct 2026 – 20 Jan 2027) → scholarship form + 250-word essay + teacher appraisal → shortlisted students interviewed.
scholarship: ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship: 100% of subsidised tuition, S$5,800/year living + S$3,000/year housing + S$1,750 computer allowance. Apply with the admission form (essay + teacher appraisal). Tuition Grant requires 3 years of work in Singapore after graduation.

name: Taylor's College (Foundation in Science)
description: Pre-university college of Taylor's University. The Foundation in Science leads to medicine, pharmacy, biotech, engineering and computing degrees.
programs: Foundation in Science → Medicine, Pharmacy, Biotech; Engineering; Computing
ged_note: GED is not listed. Taylor's International Student Recruitment team checks other qualifications. Contact internationaladmission@taylors.edu.my.
igcse_note: 5 credits including Mathematics and 2 science subjects.
admission: Check eligibility with ISR team → apply on TOPAS 9+ weeks before intake → documents → offer → student visa (eVAL, 6–8 weeks).
scholarship: Merit awards are mainly for students from Malaysian institutions. International students: ask the university.
